asked: Given a valid campaign CSV file, when the user uploads it, then the system imports the data into the dashboard.
tests: tests/e2e/analytics.spec.ts › the owner imports a CSV, the invalid row is rejected, and the dashboard shows exact KPIs and charts
planCriteria.criterion: The owner imports a CSV, the invalid row is rejected, and the dashboard shows exact KPIs and charts
Given imported campaign data, when the user views a KPI, then the system displays the value alongside the percentage change from the previous period.
Given a selected date range, when the user views the dashboard, then the system renders a time series chart of the KPIs.
Given imported campaign data, when the user selects a breakdown dimension, then the system renders a chart segmented by that dimension.
Given the dashboard is active, when the user applies a filter, then the displayed KPIs and charts update to reflect the filtered data.
Given the dashboard is populated, when the user clicks the export button, then the system generates and downloads a CSV file of the current view.

approved: Build only the covered part, "Marketing KPI Dashboard (covered part only)": the library doesn't cover 1 requirement(s) yet, removed from scope — Given a connected HubSpot account, when the system runs its nightly scheduled task, then it automatically pulls the latest campaign numbers into the dashboard.
